newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says policy not based only on forex, rates.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says policy not based only on forex, rates.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita said on Friday that the central bank does not conduct monetary policy on the basis of foreign interest rate movements and currency movements alone.
Matsushita, who was speaking to a parliamentary committee, said monetary policy should be decided by judging the overall condition of the Japanese economy.
Matsushita also said that Japan's economic recovery was starting to strengthen.
But the central bank still needed to keep watch to determine whether the recovery was secure and whether the economy would be able to overcome the effects of fiscal tightening, he said.
"Monetary policy for now is putting emphasis on strengthening the basis for economic recovery while keeping close watch over conditions," Matsushita said.
He also said that prices in Japan have, overall, stopped declining.
